trigger.novelty_evidence: The ranked and terminal structural-edge registry plus retained artifact alias search contained no Price Range Execution Rule family. The retained current Agent Native index independently lists the public executionRules and referencePrice routes.

question: Does the current official Binance Spot rule create positive incremental economic value over an otherwise identical user-bounded marketable limit order, or is it only an exchange-set taker safety cap?

endpoint_classification.operation: download the public official Binance Spot API FAQ
endpoint_classification.source_contract: The official binance/binance-spot-api-docs repository states that its documented endpoints and semantics are official and supported. This capture does not call any venue endpoint.

required_utf8_phrases: Execution rules are trading rules that are enforced at the time of order execution.
The only execution rule currently available is the Price Range rule.
This rule ensures that trades may only be executed at prices within and equal to a price range around a reference price.
The Price Range Execution Rule is not enforced on the symbol.
When an order enters its taker phase, the reference price is recalculated to set the execution price limits for the order's entire taker phase.

retained_sources.use: current official native index classifies GET /api/v3/executionRules, GET /api/v3/referencePrice, and GET /api/v3/referencePrice/calculation without USER_DATA or TRADE security labels

decision.source_gate_only: Every exact semantics phrase must exist in the one retained current official FAQ.
decision.dominance_test: For a buy taker intent with worst acceptable price P, an otherwise identical LIMIT IOC or LIMIT FOK with limit P cannot execute above P; for a sell it cannot execute below P. The exchange-set rule can only impose an additional possibly looser cap or expire residual quantity. It cannot create a positive price improvement or cash payout versus that user-bounded comparator.
decision.terminal_if_source_passes: Classify the rule as an execution-safety constraint with zero positive standalone payoff. Do not request live symbol rules merely to confirm configuration because configuration cannot reverse the dominance result. Model the rule only when a future candidate materially relies on unbounded MARKET taker execution or exact residual-expiry behavior.

retry_policy: This exact current FAQ GET is one-use. Preserve any HTTP error or missing-term response and do not retry an alias. Because the source outcome was viewed before freeze, a passing gate proves only current architecture and cannot prove live symbol configuration, account behavior, savings, fill quality, or deployment readiness.
